name: Wu-Tang Clan
hook: Nine rappers from Staten Island, one producer, kung fu films, and a record deal that let every member sign somewhere else.

blurb.age7: Nine rappers from Staten Island in New York. They loved kung fu films and put pieces of them in their songs.
blurb.age13: The Wu-Tang Clan came together in 1992 on Staten Island: RZA, GZA, Ol' Dirty Bastard, Method Man, Raekwon, Ghostface Killah, Inspectah Deck, U-God and Masta Killa. RZA made the beats. Their songs mixed dialogue from old kung fu films with dark, dusty loops. Their first album, Enter the Wu-Tang (36 Chambers), came out in 1993. RZA made a deal with their label, Loud Records, that let each member sign solo deals with other companies, so within a few years Wu-Tang members were on almost every major label.
blurb.adult: The Wu-Tang Clan are as important for their business model as for their sound. RZA's condition, which most labels refused and Loud's Steve Rifkind accepted, made each member a free agent for solo work while the group stayed together. That spread the group's sound, and RZA's production, across the industry. Ol' Dirty Bastard died in 2004.

signatureTracks.title: Protect Ya Neck
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: Their self-released first single: eight rappers in a row and kung fu film dialogue.

signatureTracks.title: C.R.E.A.M.
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: A slow, sad soul-piano loop, and their biggest single.
